knownDeltas: The per-feature result envelope (success + error per input, HTTP 200) is Esri's; with rollbackOnFailure the whole batch reports failure and the store is unchanged (atomicity is pinned by GeoServicesEditTests.Rollback_on_failure_undoes_the_whole_batch; this replay pins the response shape over the shared editable service).
Attribute-level error codes stay Esri's per-edit codes via EsriErrorMapper.EditCodeFor, not the HTTP status.
name: rollback-on-failure
notes: addFeatures with rollbackOnFailure=true and one invalid feature (missing required 'name'): every result reports success=false and nothing is stored.
source: Esri REST docs: Add Features / Apply Edits (rollbackOnFailure); the transaction path is ADR-0037
